vulnerability_behavior.preconditions_for_vulnerability: Creating a PID lock file after dropping privileges to a non-root account.
vulnerability_behavior.trigger_condition: An attacker with access to the non-root account modifies the PID lock file to contain an arbitrary PID.
vulnerability_behavior.specific_code_behavior_causing_vulnerabi: The code writes the PID lock file after dropping privileges, allowing an attacker to modify the file before it is used by a root script.

vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to drop privileges before creating the PID lock file. This ensures that the lock file cannot be modified by an attacker with lower privileges. In this case, the solution involves moving the privilege drop operation before any file creation or modification operations that involve the PID lock file.
